name: AUTOPILOT.OI All 5 Money Agents
description_html:
All 5 Money Agents for Claude, now with the Money Agents Pro setup pack. $50 separately, $39 here.

  • Bill Agent: checks a medical bill against your insurance before you pay
  • Debt Agent: payoff plan and the script to ask for a lower rate
  • Subscription Agent: lists every recurring charge and drafts the cancel messages
  • Refund Agent: drafts refund requests that name your rights
  • Raise Agent: pay data, your number and a practice run

What you get: the Subscription, Refund and Raise Agents as full agent packs, the Bill and Debt Agent kits, plus Money Agents Pro (14 pages): A setup builder that installs all 5 agents in one Claude Project in about 20 minutes, 10 setup questions, 9 commands, the worked example from our reel, cancel and refund scripts, medical bill questions and a money found tracker.

How it works: the agents run inside Claude. Each agent reads what you upload and drafts. You decide, send and call. It does not log into your accounts, move money or contact anyone for you, and it does not guarantee a result.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works).

Education only. Not legal, medical or financial advice. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
